subject: [PATCH v2 14/17] selftests/mm: add khugepaged race harness

2026-08-07.patch_summary: This patch adds a selftest harness to exercise the khugepaged functionality under concurrent access scenarios, including faults, GUP pins, fork, mremap, and MADV_DONTNEED operations. The test simulates three different driver modes: stepped (khugepaged running one full pass at a time), free (khugepaged left to run without any intervention), and madvise (MADV_COLLAPSE and MADV_DONTNEED loop). The test ensures that the racing pages are either read as their pattern or as zero, never anything else. The kernel's own assertions are also used to verify the correctness of the test.
